def compile_mjcf(facts, out):
    coord = {
        'base': None, 'front_upright': None, 'rear_upright': None,
        'front_bearing': None, 'rear_bearing': None,
        'wind_rotor': 'crank_rotation', 'crankshaft': 'crank_rotation',
        'connecting_rod': 'big_end_hinge', 'piston_slider': 'crosshead_slide',
        'wrist_pin': 'crosshead_slide', 'guide_frame': None,
        'pump_barrel': None, 'pump_rod': 'crosshead_slide',
        'pump_piston': 'crosshead_slide'
    }
    raw = [
        ('wind_rotor','crankshaft','exclude','Measured interference press fit is rigidly carried.', ['relation/rotor_press_fit','transmission/rotor_to_crankshaft_press_drive'], ['fit/crankshaft/rotor_seat/wind_rotor/hub_bore','pair/crankshaft/wind_rotor','nearby/crankshaft/wind_rotor']),
        ('crankshaft','front_bearing','exclude','Measured-clearance journal is represented by the crank hinge.', ['relation/front_shaft_journal','motion_joint/supported_crankshaft_rotation'], ['fit/front_bearing/journal_bore/crankshaft/front_journal','pair/crankshaft/front_bearing','nearby/crankshaft/front_bearing']),
        ('crankshaft','rear_bearing','exclude','Measured-clearance journal is represented by the crank hinge.', ['relation/rear_shaft_journal','motion_joint/supported_crankshaft_rotation'], ['fit/rear_bearing/journal_bore/crankshaft/rear_journal','pair/crankshaft/rear_bearing','nearby/crankshaft/rear_bearing']),
        ('crankshaft','connecting_rod','keep','Shared crankshaft/web body must remain collidable with the rod; local eccentric pin is represented by a hinge.', ['relation/crank_big_end_revolute'], ['fit/crankshaft/eccentric_pin/connecting_rod/big_end_bore','pair/connecting_rod/crankshaft','nearby/connecting_rod/crankshaft']),
        ('wrist_pin','connecting_rod','exclude','Dedicated wrist pin running fit is represented by the closure.', ['relation/rod_small_end_revolute'], ['fit/wrist_pin/pin_shaft/connecting_rod/small_end_bore','pair/connecting_rod/wrist_pin','nearby/connecting_rod/wrist_pin']),
        ('piston_slider','wrist_pin','exclude','Measured interference press fit is rigidly carried.', ['relation/wrist_pin_into_slider'], ['fit/piston_slider/wrist_pin_seat/wrist_pin/pin_shaft','pair/piston_slider/wrist_pin','nearby/piston_slider/wrist_pin']),
        ('piston_slider','pump_rod','exclude','Measured interference press fit is rigidly carried.', ['relation/pump_rod_into_slider'], ['fit/piston_slider/pump_rod_seat/pump_rod/upper_press_seat','pair/piston_slider/pump_rod','nearby/piston_slider/pump_rod']),
        ('pump_rod','pump_piston','exclude','Measured interference press fit is rigidly carried.', ['relation/pump_piston_on_rod'], ['fit/pump_rod/piston_seat/pump_piston/rod_bore','pair/pump_piston/pump_rod','nearby/pump_piston/pump_rod'])
    ]
    others = [
      ('wind_rotor','front_upright','pair/front_upright/wind_rotor','nearby/front_upright/wind_rotor'),('wind_rotor','front_bearing','pair/front_bearing/wind_rotor','nearby/front_bearing/wind_rotor'),('wind_rotor','base','pair/base/wind_rotor','nearby/base/wind_rotor'),('wind_rotor','rear_upright','pair/rear_upright/wind_rotor','nearby/rear_upright/wind_rotor'),('wind_rotor','rear_bearing','pair/rear_bearing/wind_rotor','nearby/rear_bearing/wind_rotor'),
      ('crankshaft','front_upright','pair/crankshaft/front_upright','nearby/crankshaft/front_upright'),('crankshaft','rear_upright','pair/crankshaft/rear_upright','nearby/crankshaft/rear_upright'),('crankshaft','guide_frame','pair/crankshaft/guide_frame','nearby/crankshaft/guide_frame'),('crankshaft','piston_slider','pair/crankshaft/piston_slider','nearby/crankshaft/piston_slider'),('crankshaft','wrist_pin','pair/crankshaft/wrist_pin','nearby/crankshaft/wrist_pin'),('crankshaft','pump_rod','pair/crankshaft/pump_rod','nearby/crankshaft/pump_rod'),('crankshaft','pump_barrel','pair/crankshaft/pump_barrel','nearby/crankshaft/pump_barrel'),
      ('connecting_rod','piston_slider','pair/connecting_rod/piston_slider','nearby/connecting_rod/piston_slider'),('connecting_rod','guide_frame','pair/connecting_rod/guide_frame','nearby/connecting_rod/guide_frame'),('connecting_rod','pump_rod','pair/connecting_rod/pump_rod','nearby/connecting_rod/pump_rod'),('connecting_rod','pump_barrel','pair/connecting_rod/pump_barrel','nearby/connecting_rod/pump_barrel'),('connecting_rod','rear_upright','pair/connecting_rod/rear_upright','nearby/connecting_rod/rear_upright'),('connecting_rod','rear_bearing','pair/connecting_rod/rear_bearing','nearby/connecting_rod/rear_bearing'),('connecting_rod','pump_piston','pair/connecting_rod/pump_piston','nearby/connecting_rod/pump_piston'),('connecting_rod','base','pair/base/connecting_rod','nearby/base/connecting_rod'),
      ('piston_slider','guide_frame','pair/guide_frame/piston_slider','nearby/guide_frame/piston_slider'),('piston_slider','pump_barrel','pair/piston_slider/pump_barrel','nearby/piston_slider/pump_barrel'),('piston_slider','rear_upright','pair/piston_slider/rear_upright','nearby/piston_slider/rear_upright'),('piston_slider','pump_piston','pair/piston_slider/pump_piston','nearby/piston_slider/pump_piston'),
      ('wrist_pin','guide_frame','pair/guide_frame/wrist_pin','nearby/guide_frame/wrist_pin'),('wrist_pin','pump_rod','pair/pump_rod/wrist_pin','nearby/pump_rod/wrist_pin'),
      ('pump_rod','guide_frame','pair/guide_frame/pump_rod','nearby/guide_frame/pump_rod'),('pump_rod','pump_barrel','pair/pump_barrel/pump_rod','nearby/pump_barrel/pump_rod'),('pump_rod','base','pair/base/pump_rod','nearby/base/pump_rod'),
      ('pump_piston','guide_frame','pair/guide_frame/pump_piston','nearby/guide_frame/pump_piston'),('pump_piston','pump_barrel','pair/pump_barrel/pump_piston','nearby/pump_barrel/pump_piston'),('pump_piston','base','pair/base/pump_piston','nearby/base/pump_piston')
    ]
    for a,b,p,n in others:
        raw.append((a,b,'exclude','Measured positive mesh separation or disjoint AABB shows no required solid contact; exclude exact SDF/proxy false-contact risk.', ['link/'+a,'link/'+b], [p,n]))
    contacts = []
    for a,b,act,why,src,ids in raw:
        contacts.append({'pair':[a,b], 'action':act, 'reason':why, 'source_entity_ids':src, 'fact_ids':ids})
    plan = {
      'coordinate_map':coord,
      'tree_edges':[['base','front_upright'],['base','rear_upright'],['front_upright','front_bearing'],['rear_upright','rear_bearing'],['base','guide_frame'],['base','pump_barrel'],['base','crankshaft'],['crankshaft','wind_rotor'],['crankshaft','connecting_rod'],['base','piston_slider'],['piston_slider','wrist_pin'],['piston_slider','pump_rod'],['pump_rod','pump_piston']],
      'closure_edges':[['connecting_rod','wrist_pin','small_end_connect']],
      'rigid_carried':[['crankshaft','wind_rotor'],['piston_slider','wrist_pin'],['piston_slider','pump_rod'],['pump_rod','pump_piston']],
      'independent_coaxial':[],
      'transmissions':[{'name':'rotor_to_crankshaft_press_drive','driving':'wind_rotor','driven':'crankshaft','ratio':1.0,'representation':'rigid_carried_same_coordinate'}],
      'contact_decisions':contacts,
      'support_ground':True,
      'support_strategy':'Fixed base and structural frame rest on the global ground; no support patch is required.'
    }
    out.topology_plan(plan)
    out.body('base')
    out.body('front_upright','base'); out.body('front_bearing','front_upright')
    out.body('rear_upright','base'); out.body('rear_bearing','rear_upright')
    out.body('guide_frame','base'); out.body('pump_barrel','base')
    out.body('crankshaft','base')
    out.joint('crankshaft','crank_rotation',kind='hinge',axis=(0.0,1.0,0.0),pos_mm=(0.0,0.0,110.0),frame='world')
    out.body('wind_rotor','crankshaft')
    out.body('connecting_rod','crankshaft')
    out.joint('connecting_rod','big_end_hinge',kind='hinge',axis=(0.0,1.0,0.0),pos_mm=(18.0,45.0,110.0),frame='world')
    out.body('piston_slider','base')
    out.joint('piston_slider','crosshead_slide',kind='slide',axis=(0.0,0.0,1.0),pos_mm=(0.0,45.0,40.2862997682665),frame='world')
    out.body('wrist_pin','piston_slider'); out.body('pump_rod','piston_slider'); out.body('pump_piston','pump_rod')
    out.connect('small_end_connect','connecting_rod','wrist_pin',(0.0,0.045,0.0402862997682665),'Closes the slider-crank at the dedicated wrist-pin center.',['relation/rod_small_end_revolute','relation/crank_big_end_revolute'],['fit/wrist_pin/pin_shaft/connecting_rod/small_end_bore','fit/crankshaft/eccentric_pin/connecting_rod/big_end_bore'])
    for a,b,act,why,src,ids in raw:
        if act == 'exclude': out.exclude(a,b,why,src,ids)
    ids = ['link/base','link/front_upright','link/rear_upright','link/front_bearing','link/rear_bearing','link/wind_rotor','link/crankshaft','link/connecting_rod','link/piston_slider','link/wrist_pin','link/guide_frame','link/pump_barrel','link/pump_rod','link/pump_piston','pose/place_base','pose/place_front_upright','pose/place_rear_upright','pose/place_front_bearing','pose/place_rear_bearing','pose/place_wind_rotor','pose/place_crankshaft','pose/place_connecting_rod','pose/place_piston_slider','pose/place_wrist_pin','pose/place_guide_frame','pose/place_pump_barrel','pose/place_pump_rod','pose/place_pump_piston','port/wind_rotor/hub_bore','port/crankshaft/rotor_seat','port/crankshaft/front_journal','port/crankshaft/rear_journal','port/crankshaft/eccentric_pin','port/front_bearing/journal_bore','port/rear_bearing/journal_bore','port/connecting_rod/big_end_bore','port/connecting_rod/small_end_bore','port/wrist_pin/pin_shaft','port/piston_slider/wrist_pin_seat','port/piston_slider/pump_rod_seat','port/pump_rod/upper_press_seat','port/pump_rod/piston_seat','port/pump_piston/rod_bore','relation/rotor_press_fit','relation/front_shaft_journal','relation/rear_shaft_journal','relation/crank_big_end_revolute','relation/rod_small_end_revolute','relation/wrist_pin_into_slider','relation/pump_rod_into_slider','relation/pump_piston_on_rod','motion_joint/supported_crankshaft_rotation','motion_joint/vertical_crosshead_guide','transmission/rotor_to_crankshaft_press_drive','role/driver/wind_rotor','role/output/piston_slider','role/watch/wind_rotor','role/watch/crankshaft','role/watch/connecting_rod','role/watch/piston_slider','role/watch/pump_rod','role/watch/pump_piston']
    for eid in ids:
        out.decision(eid,action='represented_by',generated_nodes=[coord.get(eid[5:]) if eid[:5]=='link/' else 'compiled_topology'],reason='Authored fact represented by the emitted spanning tree, closure, rigid carrying, or exact contact decision.',fact_ids=[eid])
